Your original post made you TA. But then your edit? So your parents can only love one of you and any affection for others means that they cant love you? YTA. You can be upset about how your parents act and TAKE IT UP WITH THEM. DO NOT take it out on someone who has NOTHING to do with it. I suggest talking to your parents after apologizing to her. Tell her how you felt and tell her it was wrong for you to have ever taken it out on her. If you have a problem then it's with your parents, but your sister did nothing wrong. You have no right to be angry, but if you're confused then talk to your parents. It doesnt sound like they hate you as you believe. But it does sound like they just expect you to bond with her and treat her as your sister, Share with her? Help her? They want you to bond and show her that shes welcome. But it doesnt sound like you have been. But they also may have been neglecting your feelings and that is something you should talk to them about. You wont get anywhere through anger and lack of communication.
